issues.description: Element: Bookstore initializer. The problem statement requires the initializer signature init(books: [Book]) (an array) (problem_statement.md lines 9-12). In the solution implementation (solution_repository/Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift) the initializer is declared as init(books: Set<Book>) (line 15), while the Bookstore property is declared as let books: [Book] (line 12). The solution's Client constructs the Bookstore with an array (Bookstore(books: books) in solution_repository/Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift line 57). This mismatch between the expected parameter type ([Book]) and the solution's initializer parameter type (Set<Book>) — combined with the property being [Book] — will cause compilation errors and confuses students about the correct API to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor parameter type consistent with the problem statement and client usage by changing the solution initializer to init(books: [Book]) and assign that array to the property (or, if Sets are intended, change the property and all call sites to use Set<Book> and update the problem statement). Prefer updating the initializer to init(books: [Book]) so the solution, the client, and the specification match.
